Heather Hedden: Are Taxonomists Ontologists (or Vice-Versa)?

Released Mar 3, 2026, 49 min

Play Heather Hedden: Are Taxonomists Ontologists (or Vice-Versa)? on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

In this video, I have the amazing privilege to meet and interview Heather Hedden. The author of the Accidental Taxonomist, Heather has wide and deep experience in the field of semantics. She's practically a celebrity. We discuss the field in general, how to enter it, what she finds interesting, and compare and contrast ontology and taxonomy.
